findings.title: All app modules are still eagerly imported at module load time
findings.body: Each property in `appStore` is assigned the result of calling `import("./...")` directly (e.g. `applecalendar: import("./applecalendar")`). Because these expressions are evaluated when `packages/app-store/index.ts` is loaded, importing `@calcom/app-store` immediately triggers dynamic imports for all 28 apps in parallel rather than loading only the requested app on demand. To defer loading until an app is accessed, each property should be a getter (e.g. `get applecalendar() { return import("./applecalendar"); }`) or a thunk (`() => import("./applecalendar")`).

findings.title: Unawaited `forEach(async ...)` leaves `apiDeletes` empty when cancelling recurring bookings
findings.body: In the recurring booking cancellation branch (`allRemainingBookings`), `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(credential); ... apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); })` uses an `async` callback inside `.forEach`. Because `.forEach` does not await promises, execution suspends at `await getCalendar(credential)` and reaches `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` (and `await apiDeletes` for paid bookings) before any `deleteEvent` calls are started or pushed into `apiDeletes`. Unlike the `else` branch on lines 477-483 (which was converted to a `for...of` loop), recurring calendar event deletions are no longer awaited before the handler returns.

findings.title: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...)` does not await deletions and bypasses `try/catch`
findings.body: Converting the `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach` callback to `async` in `packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts` (line 125), `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts` (line 125), and `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings.tsx` (line 553) causes `.forEach` to ignore the returned promises. As a result, `Reschedule` / `requestReschedule` no longer waits for `getCalendar` and `calendar.deleteEvent` / `deleteMeeting` to finish before completing, and any rejection inside the `async` callback escapes the surrounding `try / catch` block as an unhandled promise rejection instead of being caught and logged. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(async (bookingRef) => ...))` instead.
